description:
This is the official video introducing the WindFree 1Way Cassette and DVM S2 at The Orchard in Gurugram, India.

The Orchard set a new HVAC standard for premium residences by choosing the WindFree 1Way Cassette over a ducted system, paired with DVM S2. The WindFree 1Way Cassette gives each room its own setting, switches to WindFree™ cooling with no direct draft, and is only 135 mm high. DVM S2 runs multiple types of indoor units from a single unit, and uses Active AI technologies to optimize cooling performance and energy efficiency.
